newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro down 4 pct after 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro down 4 pct after 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in industrial giant Norsk Hydro slumped more than four percent early on Monday after the company posted a 10 percent decline in operating profits for 1996.
At 0920 GMT Hydro was down 16.50 crowns at 362 crowns in 54.7 million crowns of trade. The stock fell to an early intraday low at 361.0 crowns.

Norway's largest listed company said the decline in 1996 operating profits to 9.65 billion crowns compared with 10.70 billion crowns a year ago was due to significantly lower earnings for light metals and petrochemicals.
The industrial giant said its oil and gas division showed a marked improvement in operating income for the year, while results for agriculture were slightly below the year-earlier period.
